title: Greedy Pattern
intuition: Assemble solutions step-by-step using local optimum choices without looking back.
recognition_signals: Decisions do not affect past states
step_by_step_strategy: Identify sorting key or immediate criteria.
Accept if candidate is compatible with current solution, else skip.
common_mistakes: Applying greedy when DP is required
complexity: Typically O(n log n) or O(n)
content: Assemble solutions step-by-step using local optimum choices without looking back.
